name: Box Blur
description: Box blur with a horizontal and a vertical radius, applied one to three times.

params.name: radius
params.description: Horizontal radius in pixels: the box is 2 * radius + 1 wide (`lr` of boxblur, `sizeX` of avgblur)

params.name: radius_v
params.description: Vertical radius; -1 = same as `radius` (`sizeY` of avgblur)

params.name: power
params.description: How many times the box blur is applied (`lp` of boxblur; 1 gives avgblur)
